evals.name: pick-style-for-dev-tool
evals.prompt: I'm building a CLI terminal emulator web app — it's a keyboard-first developer tool with a command palette, split panes, and terminal output panels. Dark theme, high information density, precise typography. What DESIGN.md source aesthetic should I use? Pick one and explain why.

assertions.text: Selects exactly one primary source style with a slug and DESIGN.md path
Recommendation includes Color, Typography, Layout, Components, and Signature gesture DNA dimensions
Why it fits section gives 1-3 concrete reasons tied to the keyboard-first, high-density tool workflow
Includes an Avoid section that warns about brand copying or style mismatch risks
Selection rationale prioritizes product workflow fit over surface visual similarity

evals.name: pick-style-for-fintech-dashboard
evals.prompt: I'm designing a personal finance dashboard. Users connect bank accounts, see spending categorized into charts, set budgets, and get alerts. Audience is regular consumers, not traders. It should feel trustworthy, clear, and friendly — not cold or intimidating. The brief says 'friendly clarity, not Wall Street density.' What DESIGN.md style fits?

assertions.text: Selects exactly one primary source style with a slug and DESIGN.md path
Recommendation includes Color, Typography, Layout, Components, and Signature gesture DNA dimensions
Does not pick a trading-density or high-frequency data source — respects the 'friendly clarity' brief
Includes an Avoid section that warns about brand copying or style mismatch risks
If a secondary source is mentioned, it is explicitly labeled as secondary with a reason
